condition_C_intrinsics_extrinsics.method: N-view linear (DLT) triangulation, real K/R/t, no alignment

condition_D_plus_depth.method: single-view back-projection from REAL rendered depth (view 0), real K/R/t, occlusion-consistency gated (see OCCLUSION_TOL_M in source)
condition_D_plus_depth.note: nonzero error expected even with perfect pose/depth: landmark points are tube/sphere CENTERS, depth camera sees nearest SURFACE -- mean expected surface offset ~ mean landmark radius

condition_B_plus_intrinsics.method: two-view essential matrix (8-point, K known), cheirality-resolved pose, DLT triangulation, evaluated after Umeyama similarity alignment
condition_B_plus_intrinsics.note: recovered_scale_factor far from 1.0 is EXPECTED and is the finding: absolute scale is unrecoverable from images+intrinsics alone without a 3rd view or known baseline.

condition_A_images_only.method: two-view uncalibrated fundamental matrix (8-point), canonical projective reconstruction, evaluated after best-fit AFFINE alignment (generous upper bound -- true projective ambiguity is usually worse than affine-recoverable)

D_vs_C_caveat: D (single-view, 1 depth sample) is not directly comparable to C (N_VIEWS=8-view triangulation) on raw RMSE -- see hypothesis_D_depth_beats_unconditioned for D's actual comparison point (vs A, the unconditioned baseline).
